immediate_code_action.why_it_is_real_wiring: Recovery receipt_attestation receives the complete restored CURRENT snapshot. OriginalCellQ24TrainingStageV1 readback/attestation require its exact frozen Dataset cut. The existing evaluation readback adapter reconstructs the appropriate historical predecessor, but the Training typed stage has no corresponding full-snapshot consumer.
immediate_code_action.output: The original SignedLearningEvidenceV1, or original structural/binding/owner error; no synthesized evidence or timestamps.
algorithm_contract: Validate the full supplied snapshot using the existing Coordinator before reconstructing a Training predecessor.
Require the expected receipt stage to be Training (including TrainingNoUpdateV2).

If the full snapshot already contains Training, require exact equality to that retained receipt and replay only its earlier original receipts at their original observation times to obtain the Dataset prefix.

If the snapshot has only the Dataset cut, require next_stage==Training and validate the expected original receipt as that exact extension using its historical time. This supports an already completed owner whose checkpoint ACK was lost; it does not authorize new work.
Call the existing typed stage receipt_attestation on the exact Dataset prefix and expected receipt. Preserve all native/receipt CURRENT, key/trust, signature expiry and equality checks.
Do not call execute_training, fit_or_readback, attest_original_completion or checkpoint; do not mutate the supplied full snapshot or use a reconstructed prefix to substitute another owners CURRENT.
Limit the result to original Training evidence. Structural validation of later stages is not their authentication and is not a completed StageOwner implementation.
meaningful_behavior_oracles: Use existing ReceiptFixture with real native fit and real file/witness receipt owner for Candidate and quantized NoUpdate. Record that actual Training receipt into a coordinator; full-snapshot readback must return exactly the already retained signature.
Pass the original Dataset-only checkpoint with an already completed Training owner (lost ACK); readback returns the same original signature without new fit or signing.
Original native/receipt Missing or Pending remains the same original error and cannot trigger first attestation or fit.
Wrong structurally valid Dataset prefix, a replaced expected receipt and malformed/foreign full history are refused.

Repeated reads and file-object reopen preserve the four original file byte arrays, native elapsed/weights and exact receipt/signature time window. A current-witness drift or expired signature remains an error.
